title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Friday, 25 September 2026
description: Today: Oracle issues a force majeure notice over its $500bn Stargate data centre project amid gas pipeline delays; Melbourne marks AFL grand final eve with the players' parade and Kylie Minogue set to perform; Queensland's regional airfare crisis deepens as a promised review is delayed a year; and Gold Coast Suns speedster Jed Walter defends his Grand Final Sprint title. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
